messages:
maria: quick heads up  we're locking down retention windows next Wed for workspace logs. need to ensure downstream SIEM exports and partner pulls are automatically expired when ttl lapses. thoughts on an entitlement lifecycle?

jon: +1 central source of truth is needed. atm it's partially in acl-db and partially in a ticket queue.

ashley: acl-db has canonical ent records but export requests still create tickets. automation gap there.

eli: proposal: request -> entitlement record with expiry -> revoke orchestrator enforces: delete subscription, revoke KMS grant, kick bucket scrub, mark expired.

maria: can KMS grant revoke alone be our safety net? if key is revoked, partners with copies still have data.

jon: correct. key revoke prevents decrypts server-side but not already-downloaded copies. we need object deletion for internal buckets + contract clauses for partners to honor deletes.

ashley: for partner pushes include contract clause: mirror retention TTL and remote-delete on request. for internal s3 exports, tag objects and run lifecycle scrubber on revoke.

maria: i'll sketch two deliverables: (A) ticket template that creates entitlement metadata including ttl and kms notes (B) revoke job pseudo + dry-run mode.

ashley: share template pls. i'll draft partner legal language.

maria: template: ```
Title: SIEM Export Request - <consumer> - <reason>
Fields:
- Consumer: team/person
- Scope: log types + tenant
- Retention TTL (days)
- Destination: s3_internal / s3_external / api / partner
- KMS alias (if external)
- Approver
- Auto-create entitlement: yes/no
```

eli: revoke job sketch: ```python
def revoke_ent(ent_id):
    ent = acl_db.get(ent_id)
    if ent.status != 'active':
        return
    siem.delete_sub(ent.subscription_id)  # remove feed
    kms.revoke_grant(ent.kms_grant_id)   # block new decrypts
    kms.schedule_rotation(ent.kms_alias)  # backstop
    if ent.destination == 's3_internal':
        scrubber.enqueue(prefix=ent.bucket_prefix, tag='export-ent:'+ent_id)
    acl_db.update(ent_id, status='expired')
```

jon: add retry loop + escalate to oncall if revoke fails 3x. also emit audit events for entitlement.revoked / revoke_failed.

sec-bot: @maria you can send incidents events into our incident pipeline. recommend runbook with owners, retry policy, manual revoke steps, and PD escalation.

sre-oncall: recommend dry-run mode that simulates deletion and records impacted objects for validation before enabling auto-deletes.

maria: action items: ashley -> partner clause; jon/eli -> revoke job + audit events + retries; sec ops -> runbook; i'll author ticket template and PR. i'll post PR link here. :thumbsup:

eli: audit event schema idea: event_type, ent_id, actor, action, target_scope, ttl_days, reason, outcome. keeps compliance nice and searchable.

maria: perfect. also coordinating a short sync with legal/partner-ops before we enable auto remote-deletes. scheduling now.

jon: one more ask: include a checkbox on the ticket to indicate whether the consumer is allowed to retain copies offline (only for approved legal reasons).

maria: good point. adding that field to the template. will update and open draft PR.

ashley: ack, looping legal. thanks all.
